title: Dogwood Accord
description: The upper song learns to linger: a note prepared in one harmony remains while the bass changes, then resolves down a step. A separately introduced bass melody gives those suspensions a moving partner. Their meeting opens into a longer chain of fourths, sevenths and ninths, each resolving in its own voice. The final bass continues after the upper line has settled.
technical_note: Hold each tied suspension with the fingers while clearing the pedal at the bass change. The chain in bars 14–17 needs a quiet preparation and a distinct, unforced resolution. Keep the bass melody shaped independently; its last short statement follows the upper voice’s release.

performance.note: Authored phrase breathing and melodic voicing; independent rhythm is written in the score, with a shared tempo map.

composition_time_source: Recorded when the first score was saved.

audio_reverb.description: Subtle warm room; preserve the clarity of moving voices.
